dissertation_title: IoT-Based Smart Greenhouse Decision Support System for Tomato Cultivation with Simulation Dashboard
author: Fathima Hasna Mohammed Nishpar

chapter_1_introduction.1.1_background: Introduction to smart agroecology, microclimate dynamics, and tomato cultivation requirements.
chapter_1_introduction.1.1.1_current_approaches_and_limitations: Manual supervision vs hardware-bound IoT setups.
chapter_1_introduction.1.1.2_significance: Water conservation, yield optimization, risk-free simulation.
chapter_1_introduction.1.2_motivation: Hardware cost barriers and risk of crop damage during control testing.
chapter_1_introduction.1.3_research_problem: Lack of hardware-independent dual-mode greenhouse decision support systems.

1.4_aim_and_objectives.aim: Design, develop, and evaluate a dual-mode IoT-ML greenhouse DSS.

chapter_1_introduction.1.5_research_contribution: Academic (Dual-mode DSR model) and Practical (31.4% water reduction).

chapter_2_literature_review.2.1_intro: Review of agricultural IoT and ML decision support systems.
chapter_2_literature_review.2.2_topic_area_1: IoT environmental sensors and microclimate dynamics.
chapter_2_literature_review.2.3_topic_area_2: Machine Learning in precision agriculture and irrigation scheduling.
chapter_2_literature_review.2.5_challenges: High hardware costs, risk of crop damage, lack of simulation capability.
chapter_2_literature_review.2.6_research_gap: Comparison Table 1: Existing Systems vs Proposed System.

chapter_3_methodology.3.1_research_approach: Design Science Research (DSR) + Agile Scrum framework.

chapter_4_data_analysis_and_findings.4.2_ml_model_evaluation: ml_model_evaluation_metrics.json (Irrigation R^2=0.941, MAE=0.08L; Fertilizer 92.4% accuracy; Harvest MAE=2.1 days).
chapter_4_data_analysis_and_findings.4.3_comparative_analysis: 31.4% water savings vs traditional fixed irrigation schedules.

chapter_5_proposed_solution.5.3_proposed_framework: Hybrid Realtime & Background Physical Simulation Engine
chapter_5_proposed_solution.5.4_implementation_plan: Modular UI panels (Dashboard, Irrigation, Fertilizer, Harvest, History, Simulation Controls)

chapter_7_conclusion.7.2_achievement_of_objectives: Table of 5 objectives vs evidence of completion.
chapter_7_conclusion.7.4_future_recommendations: Soil pH/nutrient sensors, deep learning, mobile app extensions.
